Should readiness calls correspond to actual presentation/render observations, and are pre-applied tick, transform and motion updates intentional?
What external startup or process watchdogs, asset-failure propagation, loading policies, and scheduling paths bound a persistent pre-applied wait?
What are the valid subject-cardinality and optional-motion policies, and which of the related q1214/current ledger relationships are genuine aliases?
How does independently unavailable checkpoint3821 affect recovery, and what remains before any queue or lens disposition can be adopted by the coordinator?

The earlier unregistered ledger rg/sed preview is explicitly retained in LEDGER-REGISTRATION.json and not counted; the registered committed record was subsequently redisplayed. Navigation produced names or token line numbers only. The history selected displays and prior assessment are separately receipted. No known truncated source display or other failed read is asserted; any tests visible in source were only read as text.
limits: Static source and evidence identity checks only. No product/fixture/shader execution, viewer/capture, builds, tests, runtime probes, implementation, publication mutation or protected extraction mutation. No authorization for future runtime work is implied.
